data.summary: Microscopist on 4 field(s): density lower vs DMSO; 9 observations; candidates: Microtubule stabilizers

observations.finding: All 4 treated fields (f_0b6a5c9be8a6, f_be479bc6ca15 at 5uM; f_75b10ad68eec, f_a7108e201d88 at 50uM) are sparse/isolated cells vs DMSO f_bd4169e2e78f confluent cobblestone monolayer at same contrast - strong reduction in cells/field. No cell count z in top_deviations, so not covered.

Beta-tubulin green markedly brighter and more textured/bundled in treated cells, with high contrast filaments and rounded mitotic-like cells with dense asters vs DMSO diffuse weaker green network. Visible in all treated fields, stronger at 50uM.
Increased tubulin variation/texture: tub_glcm_contrast z=42.1 (5uM) 55.8 (50uM), tub_mean z=25.5 43.0 (0.54,0.72 vs 0.28), tub_std z=16.7 25.1 - consistent with brighter bundled tubulin seen.
Nuclei blue: many bi-nucleated, lobed/multinucleate clusters and bright condensed mitotic chromosomes; nuclei more irregular vs DMSO round oval uniformly sized nuclei.

Nuclear irregularity/multinucleation: nuc_solidity z=-16.3 -41.1 (0.966,0.956 vs 0.973), nuc_form_factor z=-18.2 at 50uM, frac_multinucleate_proxy z=10.0 at 5uM (0.58 vs 0.22) - matches visible bi/multinucleate and lobed nuclei. nuc_area z=-11.4 (665 vs 809 px) matches smaller condensed mitotic nuclei admixture.

F-actin red: DMSO shows continuous cortical red at confluent borders; treated cells isolated with contracted cortical ring and some bright puncta in rounded cells. No diffuse loss; contrast appears higher in isolated rounded cells.

Actin metrics increase: act_glcm_contrast z=11.9 32.4, act_std z=18.7, act_mean z=18.1 at 50uM (0.474 vs 0.27) - consistent with higher contrast punctate cortical actin in rounded/isolated cells, not actin disassembly.
Cells more rounded/less spread, isolated spiky or round silhouette vs DMSO polygonal epithelial spread. Dose dependent stronger at 50uM.
Cell rounding: cell_roundness z=10.8 at 5uM (0.586 vs 0.525) - matches visual rounding.

notable_cells.why: representative bright tubulin aster with condensed DNA mitotic figure; shows increased tubulin intensity/texture
cluster of multinucleated/lobed nuclei with very bright bundled tubulin, strong form factor/solidity defect at 50uM

candidate_mechanisms.why: Dominant phenotype is large increase in tubulin intensity, std and GLCM contrast (z up to 55) with bundled asters, mitotic arrest/condensed chromosomes, multinucleation and rounding. Destabilizers would decrease tubulin. Aurora/Eg5 also give multinucleation/mitosis but would not explain massive tubulin increase; measurements show nuc_area decreased not increased as in Aurora polyploidy. Consistent dose-dependent stabilization.

report.uncertainty: No separate grayscale channels; actin increase is secondary to rounding/isolation in composite. Cannot exclude other mitotic kinases but tubulin increase strongly favors stabilizer over destabilizer or actin disruptor.

## Conclusion

**Protein synthesis** (stated probability 0.68); key evidence e6, e2, e3, e8, e7.

Why: NSC vote unanimous protein synthesis with high similarity at 5 and 50 uM; dose-dependent tubulin increase noted but strong multinucleation/rounding explained by cytostatic stress; microscopy candidate noted but atlas proximity stronger per…

Next experiment if this were a real lab: Run orthogonal validation: 1h puromycin incorporation assay plus immunofluorescence for acetylated tubulin bundle quantification with a reference protein synthesis inhibitor and a reference microtubule stabilizer as comparators; and cell-cycle profiling to distinguish mitotic arrest with bundled tubulin from translational arrest.

## PI review

Verdict: approve.

Top call is justified over the runner-up. The atlas vote is unanimous (4/4 wells) for Protein synthesis, with high per-well similarity at 5 µM (0.79) and 50 µM (0.89) and a clear neighbour margin (mean 0.71 vs 0.41 for the next class), whereas Microtubule stabilizers rests on the visual tubulin interpretation. The tubulin effect itself is not a weak single-well result: it is large (tub_glcm_contrast z≈+10 to +56) and monotonic across four independently acquired doses (Spearman rho=+1.0 for tub_mean), so a replicate is unlikely to change the call. The conflicting microscopy is appropriately reflected in the calibrated probability (0.68, with 0.25 retained for the runner-up) rather than near-certainty. Budget is exhausted and no remaining free analysis would resolve atlas-vs-microscopy beyond what is already shown.

## Unblinding

Compound: **cyclohexamide** (PubChem CID [6197](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/6197))

Identity check: name and BBBC021 structure agree

ChEMBL mechanisms: 80S Ribosome inhibitor

## Verdict (computed by code)

Correct: agent said **Protein synthesis**, BBBC021 annotates **Protein synthesis**.

## Reflection

Unblinded as cyclohexamide/cycloheximide, ChEMBL 80S Ribosome inhibitor (PMID 32151059, PMID 7201003) - call Protein synthesis (p=0.68) was correct. What got right: NSC vote 4/4 in e6 with high per-well similarity at 5µM and 50µM and monotonic tub_mean dose-response rho=+1.00 across 4 doses (e8) with very large tub_glcm_contrast z=+23.9 to +55.8 (e2,e3,e5) was correctly treated as dose-dependent stress/cytostatic signal, not decisive for microtubule stabilizer. What misled/missed: strong tubulin phenotype (tub_mean z+25.5/+43.0, tub_glcm_contrast z+42.1/+55.8) plus cell_roundness, nuc_solidity -41.1 (e3) and microscopist candidate Microtubule stabilizers in e7 suggested direct target; e10 correctly retained 0.25 for that runner-up instead of over-certainty. Acquisition: 4 wells (0.5-50µM) captured onset (e4 z+9.8) to max effect and distinguished actin vs tub (e9 rho=-0.80 n.s.); no orthogonal puromycin/acetylated-tubulin comparator was acquired to resolve atlas-vs-microscopy further, but was proposed as next experiment.

What was right:
- e6 NSC 4/4 Protein synthesis with neighbor k=5/10 Protein synthesis, 5/10 Epithelial
- e2/e3/e5 large monotonic tubulin increases and e8 rho=+1.00
- e10 calibrated 0.68/0.25 weighting vs e7 microscopy

What was wrong or missed:
- e7 visual microtubule stabilizer candidate and e2/e3 tubulin z-scores mimicked stabilization/bundling
- nuc_solidity and roundness confounded as cytostatic stress not mitotic arrest

Proposed next experiment: puromycin incorporation + acetylated tubulin with reference protein synthesis inhibitor and microtubule stabilizer controls
